payload.core_mechanism_summary: Find all values with frequency > 1 as mandatory anchors; then include any value that is a subset (bitwise) of at least one anchor. Subset check uses bitwise AND/OR to ensure all bits of u are in v.
payload.rationale: The solution deduces that any calm group must have a duplicate; then optimally takes all subsets of all duplicates. This is a constructive global optimum, not a sequential greedy choice, but the reasoning parallels greedy exchange: including all possible subset elements cannot worsen the solution.
